artifact:
Feature: Lab Request Routing and Management

  Scenario: Lab requests are routed to the Laboratory
    Given a patient with pincode "12345"
    When the patient submits a lab request
    Then the request should be routed to the Laboratory

  Scenario: Lab personnel make appointments and perform home collection
    Given lab personnel are logged in
    When they make an appointment for a patient with pincode "12345"
    And they perform home collection of the specimen
    Then the appointment should be confirmed and specimen collected

  Scenario: Reports are sent to patients directly
    Given a patient with pincode "12345"
    When the lab personnel send a report
    Then the report should be sent to the patient's email or address

  Scenario: Patients upload reports
    Given a patient with pincode "12345"
    When the patient uploads a report of size 1 MB
    Then the report should be accepted and stored

  Scenario: Patients upload multiple reports
    Given a patient with pincode "12345"
    When the patient uploads 5 reports of size 1 MB each
    Then all reports should be accepted and stored

  Scenario: Patients upload reports exceeding size limit
    Given a patient with pincode "12345"
    When the patient uploads a report of size 2 MB
    Then the report should be rejected with an error message

  Scenario: Patients upload more than 5 reports
    Given a patient with pincode "12345"
    When the patient uploads 6 reports of size 1 MB each
    Then the additional reports should be rejected with an error message

  Scenario: Consultation requests are routed to a Doctor
    Given a patient with pincode "12345"
    When the patient submits a consultation request
    Then the request should be routed to a Doctor of the specified speciality

  Scenario: Machine Learning Algorithm predicts diseases
    Given a patient with pincode "12345"
    When the patient submits symptoms
    Then the Machine Learning Algorithm should predict a disease

  Scenario: Doctors accept or modify diagnoses
    Given a patient with pincode "12345"
    When a Doctor accepts or modifies a diagnosis
    Then the diagnosis should be updated

  Scenario: Doctors perform diagnoses
    Given a patient with pincode "12345"
    When a Doctor performs a diagnosis
    Then the diagnosis should be recorded
